most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 shares the exact core myth: the fertility king, child of earth and sky deities, brother-husband of the goddess, murdered and dismembered by his jealous brother, whose body the goddess and her sister search out and reassemble, magically reviving him to conceive a son who avenges him while the father rules the dead.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 7 is a bare account of an ancestor-turned-creator figure who makes humans from reeds and forgets them, with no dismembered king, searching sister-wife, avenging son, or any comparable episodes.
